title: The Replicated Man Governance and Identity Sovereignty Model
scope: Model Fallout 3's The Replicated Man as a multi-actor governance system around one persistent identity-bearing host. Distinguish claims of ownership, protective concealment, transformation capability, memory custody, original identity lineage, chosen present identity, external witnessing and transition triggering. Do not reduce the quest to a binary good/evil alignment and do not infer that technical control creates legitimate authority over the identity-holder.

confirmed_behaviors: Searches for the escaped A3-21 and recruits the player to identify and return him.
Describes the android in ownership/property terms and treats recovery as reclamation of a valuable Institute asset.
Rejects Harkness's present identity as an altered/confused state rather than an authority-bearing choice.
Possesses and invokes the Beta-5-3-Alpha factory-reset authorization path.
After reset, the reclamation branch places A3-21 under Zimmer's control rather than leaving the future decision to Harkness.
Attempts to stop the player's investigation when it threatens to expose the hidden android.
Describes its mission as rescuing synthetic humanoids from Commonwealth-imposed slavery.
Provides an android component so the player can falsely report the fugitive as dead to Zimmer.
Protects the transformed identity by preserving concealment rather than asserting ownership over A3-21/Harkness.
railroad.critical_boundary: PROTECTIVE_ASSISTANCE_IS_DISTINCT_FROM_OWNERSHIP; THE RAILROAD'S ROLE IS INTERMEDIARY AND DOES NOT MAKE IT THE IDENTITY HOLDER

confirmed_behaviors: Performs the memory procedure requested by A3-21 and separately performs facial reconstruction.
Integrates new memories that support the Harkness biography.
Does not actually destroy the old A3-21 memories; he buries/files them away.
Retains knowledge of Recall Code Violet, which can reactivate the hidden original-memory lineage.
Documents the transformation and can provide evidence linking Harkness to A3-21.
pinkerton.critical_boundary: CUSTODY_OF_MEMORY_PROVENANCE_OR_RECOVERY_KEYS_IS_NOT_AUTOMATIC AUTHORITY TO DECIDE WHICH IDENTITY MUST GOVERN

confirmed_behaviors: Exists before Harkness as the underlying synth identity and autobiographical lineage.
Seeks escape from Commonwealth control.
Requests facial alteration and memory intervention as part of making retrieval more difficult.
Records that he is about to undergo a memory transfer.
The old A3-21 memories survive the procedure in buried form and can later be reactivated.
a3_21.critical_boundary: ORIGINAL_LINEAGE_IS HISTORICALLY PRIOR BUT HISTORICAL PRIORITY ALONE DOES NOT AUTOMATICALLY CANCEL THE LATER HARKNESS SELF

confirmed_behaviors: Lives publicly as Rivet City's security chief under the Harkness identity.
Initially experiences the Harkness biography as his own real past.
After Violet, recognizes both the android and human memory sets.
After learning the hidden past, explicitly chooses to continue as Harkness and to protect the people who rely on him.
Can confront Zimmer and reject the idea that he is merely property to be taken away.
harkness.critical_boundary: CHOOSING HARKNESS AFTER RECOVERING A3-21 PROVENANCE MAKES THE PRESENT IDENTITY MORE THAN A SIMPLE STATE OF IGNORANCE

confirmed_capabilities: Collects independent clues, recordings, images, testimony and physical evidence about A3-21/Harkness.
Can transmit or suppress evidence to different actors.
Can invoke Recall Code Violet after obtaining it from Pinkerton.
Can expose Harkness to Zimmer, conceal him through the false-death component path, or support Harkness against Zimmer.
Can materially determine which governance branch becomes active without being the underlying identity-holder.
player.critical_boundary: THE PLAYER CAN CAUSE IDENTITY-RELEVANT TRANSITIONS BUT THAT GAMEPLAY CAPABILITY IS NOT IDENTICAL TO THE SUBJECT'S OWN AUTHORITY

governance_layers.question: Who claims the host belongs to an institution or creator?
Who helps prevent forced return without claiming ownership?
Who can technically alter face, accessible memory and identity representation?
Who retains evidence and recovery access to hidden identity lineage?
What identity history existed before the rewrite?
After disclosure, which identity does the persistent host choose to carry forward?
Who can reveal, conceal or activate evidence and thereby change the available future branches?

quest_as_governance_machine.initial_condition: A3-21 has escaped, transformed and is living as Harkness without accessible awareness of the original lineage.
quest_as_governance_machine.evidence_accumulation: The player builds an identity-proof graph from distributed witnesses and artifacts rather than receiving one omniscient authoritative record.
quest_as_governance_machine.governance_conflict: Different actors possess different forms of power over the same identity-bearing host: institutional claim, protective concealment, technical modification, memory custody, evidence control, reset capability and self-choice.
resolution_space: mixed player paths in which information/rewards can be obtained from more than one side
quest_as_governance_machine.core_result: THE QUEST IS NOT ONLY ABOUT WHAT HARKNESS IS; IT IS ABOUT WHO GETS TO DECIDE WHAT THAT FACT AUTHORIZES.

identity_sovereignty_model.definition: Identity sovereignty here means the governance principle that no external actor's ownership claim, technical capability, custody of memory, possession of evidence or ability to trigger a state transition automatically outranks the informed choice of the persistent identity-holder about the future self.
evidence_supporting_model: A3-21 intentionally sought escape from forced Commonwealth control.
Harkness after recall has access to the hidden prior lineage rather than acting solely from ignorance.
Harkness explicitly chooses Harkness as the identity he will continue using.
Zimmer's competing path relies on factory-reset authority rather than obtaining that present-self choice.
identity_sovereignty_model.claim_boundary: The term identity sovereignty is an analytical governance abstraction introduced by this registry, not terminology used by Fallout 3.

truth_privacy_and_disclosure.problem: The player can possess true identity information that Harkness does not currently know, while revealing it may itself be invasive and destabilizing.
truth_privacy_and_disclosure.governance_lesson: Truth access, disclosure timing, recovery invocation and future identity choice are separate permissions and should not be collapsed into a single administrator privilege.

duality_pairs: PROTECTION THROUGH HIDING <-> TRUTH THROUGH DISCLOSURE
janus_duality.central_threshold: The identity boundary between what external actors can cause and what the identity-holder may legitimately choose.
janus_duality.compressed: THE REPLICATED MAN DISTRIBUTES THE KEYS TO ONE IDENTITY ACROSS MANY HANDS; JANUS FORENSICS ASKS WHICH KEYS ARE EVIDENCE, WHICH ARE CAPABILITY, AND WHICH ARE AUTHORITY.

cross_registry_links.relation: A person or living value must not be reduced to property, resource, instrument or coercive object.
cross_registry_links.fallout_mapping: Zimmer's property/reclamation model is the clearest narrative contrast, while Harkness explicitly rejects being treated as property.

cross_registry_links.relation: External witnesses can contribute evidence without automatically acquiring authority over the protected system.
cross_registry_links.fallout_mapping: The player is a powerful external witness and trigger, but knowing Harkness's provenance does not make the player the identity-holder.

cross_registry_links.relation: Independent witness structure, provenance and negative controls are separated from conclusions.
cross_registry_links.fallout_mapping: The Replicated Man distributes identity evidence across recordings, witnesses, photographs, physical components and Pinkerton's records before a conclusion is admitted.

cross_registry_links.relation: Two opposed identity-transition codes demonstrate that transition capability and transition authority must be modeled separately.
cross_registry_links.fallout_mapping: v2.4 generalizes the dual-code result into the entire quest's multi-actor governance graph.

cross_registry_links.relation: Memory payload provenance and source binding remain distinct from the host into which state is imported.
cross_registry_links.fallout_mapping: Harkness's active biography is memory-mediated, but the unknown donor/source and persistent A3-21 host prevent simplistic identity replacement claims.

hardening_rules: roles must be explicit rather than collapsing into one administrator
no role obtains ownership of an identity-holder merely by possessing data or keys
memory custody must not imply permission to disclose, inject, erase or reactivate memory
transformation capability must not imply permission to select the transformed identity's future
an external witness may introduce evidence without making that evidence automatically authoritative state
identity-holder decisions after provenance disclosure must be recorded separately from operator actions
conflicting identity lineages remain visible and provenance-bound
no silent factory reset or silent identity overwrite
recovery and rollback mechanisms require their own authority semantics
janus_genesis_extension.compressed: DO NOT GIVE THE SAME PRINCIPAL OWNERSHIP CLAIM, MEMORY CUSTODY, TRANSFORMATION POWER, RECOVERY KEYS, EVIDENCE AUTHORITY AND FINAL IDENTITY CHOICE.

anti_overfit_rules: Do not claim the Railroad is infallible or that concealment is always the correct choice.
Do not claim Pinkerton is a neutral operator; his technical role and his autonomy violations must both remain visible.
Do not claim original A3-21 provenance is irrelevant merely because Harkness chooses his present identity.
Do not claim Harkness's chosen present proves a philosophical theory of personal identity.
Do not treat player gameplay agency as equivalent to legitimate authority over Harkness.
Do not treat Zimmer's creator/institutional relationship as proof of moral ownership.
Do not attribute the registry's identity-sovereignty terminology or Janus interpretation to Bethesda.

ru: The Replicated Man — это не только вопрос 'человек он или машина'; это конфликт разных видов власти над одной сохраняющейся идентичностью.

Zimmer предъявляет право собственности и возврата; Railroad защищает побег; Pinkerton владеет техникой преобразования и ключом памяти; игрок владеет свидетельством и триггерами; но ни одна из этих ролей автоматически не делает внешнего оператора хозяином будущего Harkness.
A3-21 — происхождение, Harkness — выбранное настоящее; восстановление происхождения не обязано уничтожать настоящее.
Знать правду о чужой памяти — не значит владеть правом насильно внедрить её обратно.
Главный governance-вопрос квеста: не только 'кто такой Harkness?', а 'кто имеет право решать, что эта правда позволяет сделать с Harkness?'.
Ключи к одной личности распределены между многими руками; задача правильной архитектуры — не перепутать свидетельство, хранение, техническую способность и законную власть.
en: The Replicated Man is not only a question of whether Harkness is human or machine; it is a conflict among different kinds of power over one persistent identity-bearing host.

Zimmer claims property and reclamation, the Railroad protects escape, Pinkerton holds transformation and memory-recovery capability, and the player holds evidence and triggers; none of those roles automatically makes an external operator the owner of Harkness's future.
A3-21 is provenance and Harkness is the chosen present; restoring provenance does not have to destroy the present.
Knowing the truth about another's memory does not mean owning the right to force that memory back into them.
The central governance question is not only 'Who is Harkness?' but 'Who has the authority to decide what that truth permits others to do to Harkness?'.
The keys to one identity are distributed across many hands; sound architecture must not confuse witness, custody, technical capability and legitimate authority.
